Default mode is strategy-oriented for non-developer readers (testers, PM, ops, managers): explain decision order and policy logic instead of dumping function bodies. Every claim must carry a file:line reference verified to exist by the bundled scripts. Produce Markdown only when the user explicitly asks for it.
